title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README, which covers Windows setup, the first Zalo run, the desktop app and web admin, and VPS control. PROJECT_MAP.md adds a map of modules by layer and subsystem, giving you the roadmap for the rest of the tour.

title: Entry Points and CLI
description: Running python -m bot enters __main__.py, which delegates to the main CLI in command_line.py. That module wires together the run loop, console mode, Zalo QR login, health checks, updates, and the admin UI. The pyproject.toml declares the dependencies (httpx, google-genai, FastAPI) and the packaging metadata.
languageLesson: A __main__.py file makes a package runnable with python -m, and a console-script entry in pyproject.toml exposes the same main() function as a command.

title: Configuration and Paths
description: Building on the CLI, config.py loads settings from environment variables into a frozen Settings dataclass that most modules depend on. userdata_paths.py resolves where user data lives for frozen and source runs. The env.example template shows which settings you must provide.
languageLesson: A frozen dataclass gives immutable, typed settings that are safe to share across modules.

title: Receiving Zalo Messages
description: The Zalo integration layer turns platform traffic into a normalized IncomingMessage. Messages arrive through long-polling or a FastAPI webhook, and the Bot Platform client sends replies. The QR login flow and the personal-account adapter are alternative ways to connect.

title: Message Handling Core
description: The central Bot class in message_handler.py takes each IncomingMessage and applies filtering, rate limiting, and roles. It also dispatches owner commands before anything reaches the AI agent. The helper modules each cover one concern: message_filter decides whether to respond, roles and rate_limiter enforce permissions and throttling, and owner_commands runs admin chat commands.

title: The Gemini Agent
description: Messages that pass the core checks go to GeminiAgent, which runs a tool-calling loop with retries and token usage tracking. The system prompt is built from cached prompt files plus the current Vietnam time. The SYSTEM.md template holds the default Vietnamese role and answer style.

title: Agent Tools
description: Tools extend the agent beyond conversation. The registry in agent/tools/__init__.py defines the Tool abstraction and auto-discovers built-in and external tool modules. Concrete tools read chat memory, assign calendar events, and call the schedule web API.

title: Reply Formatting
description: Before replies go back to Zalo, they pass through formatting helpers. These count UTF-16 length, split long messages to platform limits, and convert plain-text names into Zalo mention tags. Accent-insensitive matching comes from the small text_fold helper.

title: Persistent Storage
description: The storage package keeps bot state: groups, seen messages, history, memory, usage, and more. data_stores.py builds on the atomic JSON-lines helpers in text_files.py. process_lock.py stops two bot processes from running at once.

title: System and Remote Services
description: The system package manages the bot's lifecycle: process control, git-based auto-update, and data handover between a local machine and a VPS. It also syncs remote config through the remote server client. docs/vps-dieu-khien.md explains how the VPS control workflow looks from the user side.

title: Admin Web UI
description: The admin server is a FastAPI app exposing settings, bot control, handover, and status endpoints. It authenticates through admin_sessions and edits the env file through settings_file. The static index.html and admin_page.js form the single-page dashboard that calls it.

title: Desktop App
description: The desktop app combines the admin server, a system tray (pystray), bot controls, update checks, and VPS handover into one Windows GUI. Windows autostart is managed through the registry.

title: Packaging and Deployment Scripts
description: The scripts turn the project into a distributable Windows tool. build-exe.ps1 and the PyInstaller spec build a single-file ZaloBot.exe, and check_secrets.py verifies no secrets are bundled. ZaloBot.cmd and the Task Scheduler scripts handle launching and keeping the bot alive.

title: Tests
description: The pytest suite shows expected behavior. conftest.py supplies fakes (FakeZalo, FakeAgent, FakeWeb) and factories, test_bot.py exercises the full message pipeline, and test_admin.py covers the admin API.
languageLesson: pytest fixtures in conftest.py are shared automatically across test files, and fake objects replace network services to keep tests fast and deterministic.
